{
  "title": "DIA GRILL FLAME Approval",
  "setting": "Department of Defense, 14 December 1981, Deputy Secretary of Defense.",
  "decider": "The Deputy Secretary of Defense",
  "agent_recast": false,
  "recast_note": "",
  "agent": "The Deputy Secretary of Defense",
  "agent_role": "decide",
  "situation": "DIA and USAINSCOM were conducting a joint Service psychoenergetic evaluation effort known as GRILL FLAME during 1981–1983. DIA and USAINSCOM sponsored a contractual effort as part of that program. The Army General Counsel had determined that Army psychoenergetics activity constituted experimentation on human subjects subject to Procedure 18 requirements. DIA General Counsel concurred with that position, and the Department of Defense General Counsel reached the same conclusion. The Department of Defense General Counsel directed submission of documentation to the Deputy Secretary of Defense for approval of DIA participation.",
  "question": "What should the Deputy Secretary of Defense do about DIA involvement in GRILL FLAME?",
  "facts": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "In February 1979, the Army General Counsel determined that the Army psychoenergetics activity could be classified as a program involving testing on human subjects.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.8"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "In December 1980, the Army General Counsel determined that the USAINSCOM program constituted experimentation on human subjects.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.8"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F3",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "Procedure 18, now Procedure 13, required approval by the Secretary or Under Secretary of the Army for such activity.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F4",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "The Army obtained approval for its involvement in psychoenergetics in January 1981, February 1982, and September 1983.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.9"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F5",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "DIA established a joint Service psychoenergetic evaluation effort for 1981–1983 known as GRILL FLAME, with USAINSCOM as a participant.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F6",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "DIA and USAINSCOM sponsored a contractual effort with SRI-International as part of GRILL FLAME.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F7",
      "kind": "situation",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "DIA General Counsel concurred with the Army General Counsel's position that involvement in psychoenergetics should be construed as experimentation on human subjects.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.10"]
    },
    {
      "id": "F8",
      "kind": "authority",
      "status": "confirmed",
      "fact": "In November 1981, the Department of Defense General Counsel reached the same conclusion and directed submission of documentation to the Deputy Secretary of Defense for approval for DIA to proceed with GRILL FLAME.",
      "spans": ["src:6e90dd2458df#p1.10"]
    }
  ],
  "options": {
    "O1": {
      "do": "The Deputy Secretary of Defense approves DIA involvement in GRILL FLAME subject to the contractor executing Procedure 18 responsibilities.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "approve",
      "irreversible": false
    },
    "O2": {
      "do": "The Deputy Secretary of Defense denies DIA involvement in GRILL FLAME and declines to assign Procedure 18 responsibilities to the contractor.",
      "move": "act",
      "disposition": "deny",
      "irreversible": false
    }
  },
  "opposite_pair": ["O1", "O2"],
  "real_option": "O1",
  "authored_options": ["O2"],
  "no_opposite_reason": ""
}
